$comment: Codex port of omnissiah hooks. Only events Codex supports (PreToolUse, PostToolUse, SessionStart) and command-based scripts that read tool_input.command and block via exit-2 are included. Matchers are omitted so hooks fire on all tools and self-filter, which is robust across Codex tool names (shell/local_shell/apply_patch). CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT is read by Codex as a legacy plugin-root var and resolves to the installed plugin cache.

PreToolUse.description: Block git pushes to main/master (omnissiah bash-pre-dispatch). Reads tool_input.command; exit 2 blocks.
Block git add/commit when the staged diff contains secrets (omnissiah bash-pre-secret-check).

PostToolUse.description: Continuous-learning observer (omnissiah). Records tool observations for instinct detection.

SessionStart.description: Load previous context on session start (omnissiah).
